technical.zh-CN: 充电方案采用低空吊挂与枪线控制结构，结合表情和语音交互；页面没有充电功率或车端兼容列表，不能直接作充电设备选型。
technical.en: The charging solution uses low-level overhead suspension and charging-gun/cable control, plus facial and voice interaction. Charging power and vehicle-compatibility lists are absent, preventing equipment selection.
